$comment: Structural POST /v1/workflows request generated from the exact tt_core::routes::workflows::CreateWorkflowRequest parser. Runtime semantic validation, authorization, readiness, and execution remain separate gates.

max_cost_usd.description: Hard USD cap for the entire workflow run.

on_exceed.description: What to do when the cap is exceeded.

DocumentSource.description: Where a [`DocumentPart`]'s bytes come from: a remote/`data:` URL or inline base64. Serializes to Anthropic's source convention (`{"type":"url",...}` / `{"type":"base64","media_type":...,"data":...}`).

oneOf.description: Remote document URL (or an unparsed `data:` URL).
Inline base64-encoded document bytes with their media type.

map.description: Optional jq/expression to map the source output before passing it on.

ModelSelection.description: Determines which model (or routing rule) a `Model`/`Agent` node uses. Serialised with a `"type"` discriminant matching the variant name in snake_case.

oneOf.description: A named TokenTrimmer route (resolved at runtime).
Let the gateway pick the best model automatically.

Node.description:
A single DAG node.  The `id` field lives in the wrapper so every node kind shares a common identifier without repetition.

# Serde approach `#[serde(flatten)]` spreads `NodeKind`'s fields (including the `"type"` tag) into the parent JSON object.  Combined with the internally-tagged `NodeKind`, this round-trips cleanly for JSON.

NOTE: #[serde(flatten)] + internal tag works only with self-describing formats (JSON); do not serialize with CBOR/MessagePack.

oneOf.description: Entry-point node; receives the workflow's external input.

max_output_tokens.description: Optional per-call output-token ceiling.  Omitted definitions retain legacy provider-default behavior; capped workflow admission requires this to be explicitly set.

oneOf.description: Agentic multi-turn loop with tool access.

max_output_tokens.description: Optional ceiling for each model turn's completion.  It does not bound the number of turns; see `max_turns`.

max_turns.description: Turn cap for the agent loop; None => the engine's default (DEFAULT_MAX_TURNS = 8, matching CreateRunRequest).

oneOf.description: Conditional branch; exactly one outgoing edge is followed at runtime.

Outbound HTTP call to an allowlisted external API.

The `url` host must be a literal hostname that appears in `WorkflowDefinition::allowed_hosts` (default-deny).  Only the path, query-string, headers, and body may contain `{{template}}` tokens; the host must be a static literal so the allowlist is unambiguous.

Execute another stored workflow as a nested child (W3a-3).

`version` is accepted for forward-compatibility but UNUSED at MVP — `load_subworkflow` always returns the latest version. The parent's remaining budget cap is passed to the child; cost and baseline roll up into the parent totals so `saved_usd` derives correctly without double-counting.
Bounded loop — runs the body sub-workflow up to `max_iters` times, re-checking `cond` (Branch syntax) before each iteration. Termination GUARANTEED by `max_iters`; `cond` is early-exit.

D6 — distill a document's text layer to text downstream nodes can use.

Reuses the gateway's Document Lane seam, so workflow and routed-request extraction agree. The cache identity covers organization, decoded source bytes (BLAKE3), normalized media type, optional caller key, immutable sidecar revision, and TokenTrimmer policy revision. A hit returns cached text without a sidecar call; missing revision provenance bypasses reuse. A miss calls the sidecar and stores a successful result. A sidecar error emits an error `NodeOutput`; raw bytes are never mislabeled as text.

`source` may be inline base64 or an HTTPS URL fetched through the same no-redirect, DNS-pinned, closed-media-set, byte-capped transport as the workflow HTTP node. `cache_key`, when present, is a template such as `"{{trigger.input_id}}"` composed into the semantic cache identity.

OnExceed.description: Action taken when a budget limit is hit.  Only `Stop` is implemented in W1a; warn/throttle/etc. are deferred.

WorkflowTrigger.description: A workflow invoker (CO-2). Distinct from `NodeKind::Trigger` (the passive entry-point node that echoes the run's `inputs`); these are OUT-OF-BAND invokers the cloud surfaces — a schedule a sweep fires, or a signed webhook an external caller POSTs. The engine never reads them; the cloud's `workflow_schedule` sweep + the `/v1/workflows/:id/webhooks/:token` endpoint are the consumers.

oneOf.description: Fire on a fixed interval. `interval` is a duration string (`"1h"` / `"6h"` / `"1d"`) and new definitions must be at least one hour. The cloud dispatcher picks due work up on an approximate hourly sweep, not at an exact wall-clock time. No real-cron expressions in v1 (no cron crate dep — the cloud sweeps are fixed-`Duration` sleeps; mirroring that keeps the cadence discipline uniform).

environment.description: Optional immutable release environment resolved when this trigger occurrence is durably accepted. Omission preserves the historical latest-saved-definition behavior.

oneOf.description: Fire via a signed webhook URL. `token_id` is the public trigger identifier embedded in the v2 capability path (`POST /v1/workflows/:id/webhooks/{org_uuid}.{token_id}.{hex_sig}`); the HMAC secret is derived server-side under a `wfwh2|{org_id}|{workflow_id}|{token_id}` domain. Binding the tenant is required because workflow ids are tenant-scoped. This reuses the badge-HMAC key + the `verify_receipt_share_url` idiom.

environment.description: Optional immutable release environment resolved when this trigger occurrence is durably accepted. Omission preserves the historical latest-saved-definition behavior.

WorkflowTriggerEnvironment.description: Closed release selector available to automatic workflow triggers. This is deliberately the same three-value wire vocabulary as direct and route execution, while remaining in the pure definition model consumed by Cloud.

description: `POST /v1/workflows` request body. `id` and `version` are optional: if `id` is absent a new `UUIDv4` is generated, while `version` remains ignored. `expected_latest_version` is a write-only optimistic precondition: `0` requires no retained version, and a positive value must match the current latest version before the immutable next version is appended.

metadata.description: Freeform editor metadata forwarded to `WorkflowDefinition::metadata` (WF-3: canvas node positions, previously localStorage-only). Optional + defaulted so a save without it (an older editor) is unchanged.

triggers.description: Out-of-band workflow invokers (schedule and signed webhook).  These must round-trip on every definition update: dropping them silently disables production automations.
